$description: Closed values the UI iterates over or waits on (declarations over code). `data_sources` are the server's sources (adapters/observer/server.py). Times are milliseconds: `poll_ms` how often the app asks whether the store changed; a failed answer is asked again after twice the wait, up to `backoff_cap_ms`; a run's details that failed are asked again after `retry_ms` doubling up to `backoff_cap_ms`, `retries` times, and always by the Retry button; `copied_ms` how long a copy button says Copied. `hosts` are the hosts whose names the copy knows (an unknown host is shown by the id it recorded). Value lists are not here: they are generated from the contract (enums.json).
